title: Ordinary finite quotient models and positive root endpoints
statement: Let l be prime, Y a scheme with P=ProjectiveLine Y and W=diagonalSurface Y, all Noetherian, and let l be invertible on Y. Let E be a finite intermediate field of the fixed algebraic closure of Q_l, pi a generator of the maximal ideal of its valuation ring, and n a natural number. Write B=O_E/(pi)^(n+1), R for its continuous-function condensed ring and A=ULift B. Assume A finite, l^(n+1)=0 in A, and l^(n+1) invertible on Y and W. Supply kernel-normalized FiniteRoots on P and W [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-diagrams]. There exist FiniteRealizations eY,eP,eW [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-finite-realization] and QuotientLineRealizations lineP,lineW at exponent n [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-quotient-line]. There also exist an isomorphism eW(source R Y) to the ordinary direct image along the diagonal of the constant A-module, whose underlying map is exactly the direct image of eP's specified coefficient-unit comparison, and an ordinary functor isomorphism q_* followed by eY to eP followed by ordinary A-module q_*. On every internal module, composing its underlying isomorphism with q_* of eP's underlying comparison equals eY's underlying comparison. This statement contains no completed arrow, coefficient family, scalar-compatible diagram, class equality, trace equality or derived comparison.

source.place: paragraph (1), finite reductions of the coefficient objects, diagonal class and trace

proof.text: Use the finite-discrete unital point ring comparison. Choose the concrete internal-action-to-module encoding; its regular-module isomorphism has underlying identity. Apply the normalized unit comparison on every scheme, retaining the explicitly constructed inverse encoding and underlying-sheaf comparison to construct a family of FiniteRealizations.

The existing sectionwise ordinary pushforward isomorphism for this same encoding has the required underlying normalization. It gives FiniteOrdinaryPushSquare for every scheme morphism. At the diagonal, compose its component at the regular module with the direct image of eP.unitIso. Cancel the underlying isomorphisms in the square normalization to obtain the exact FiniteSourceComparison normalization.

Pull invertibility of l from Y to P and W. Apply the single-scheme quotient root endpoint theorem on P and W to the supplied FiniteRoots and the constructed finite realizations. Together with the source comparison and q square these give the stated witnesses.

proof_origin.note: Lean construction of the realization family and normalized ordinary squares; supported source is derived by categorical cancellation. The two remaining steps are regular-unit normalization and the single-scheme quotient root endpoint.

theorem diagonalUniformizer_finiteModels
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)] [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l) (π : PadicAlgCl.integers l E)
    (hπ : Ideal.span {π} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicAlgCl.integers l E)) (n : ℕ)
    [hfinite : Finite (ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n))]
    (hA : ((l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n)) = 0)
    (hYpow : IsUnit ((l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (hWpow : IsUnit ((l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : Γ(diagonalSurface Y, ⊤)))
    (rootsP : FiniteRoots (ProjectiveLine Y) (l ^ (n + 1)))
    (rootsW : FiniteRoots (diagonalSurface Y) (l ^ (n + 1))) :
    ∃ (eY : FiniteRealization
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
      (ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n)) Y)
    (eP : FiniteRealization
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
      (ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n)) (ProjectiveLine Y))
    (eW : FiniteRealization
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
      (ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n)) (diagonalSurface Y))
      (lineP : QuotientLineRealization l E π n n hA (ProjectiveLine Y) eP)
      (lineW : QuotientLineRealization l E π n n hA (diagonalSurface Y) eW),
    Nonempty (FiniteSourceComparison
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
      (ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n)) Y eP eW) ∧
    Nonempty (FiniteOrdinaryPushSquare
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
      (ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n)) (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) eP eY)
